CONVERSATION_PANEL.TITLE: Conversations Panel
CONVERSATION_PANEL.SUBTITLE: Who is being served and who is waiting in the queue, right now.
CONVERSATION_PANEL.ERROR: Could not load the panel. Trying again.

GREEN.TITLE: Being served by an agent
GREEN.INFO: This number is the total of OPEN conversations that already have an agent, meaning they were assigned to someone. The customer is already being served. Paused, snoozed and resolved conversations are not included.

ORANGE.TITLE: Waiting in the queue
ORANGE.HINT: in the queue, no agent, up to {minutes} min
ORANGE.INFO: This number is the total of OPEN conversations in the queue: the customer has reached out but no agent has been assigned yet. These have been waiting up to {minutes} min, counted from the customer's last message. Paused, snoozed and resolved conversations are not included.

RED.TITLE: Waiting for a long time
RED.HINT: in the queue, no agent, over {minutes} min
RED.INFO: This number is the total of OPEN conversations in the queue, with no agent, waiting for MORE than {minutes} min, counted from the customer's last message. These need attention the most right now. Paused, snoozed and resolved conversations are not included.

STATS.AVERAGE_HINT: Today: from the customer arriving to the first reply
STATS.LONGEST_HINT: Customer in the queue waiting the longest now

LIST.TITLE: Conversations: {band}
LIST.TRUNCATED: Showing the {shown} with the longest wait out of {total}.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Conversations Panel
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Green: conversations already assigned to an agent. Orange: conversations in the queue, with no agent. Red: conversations in the queue with no agent for longer than the limit below (counted from the customer's last message). Who can see the panel is set in the Custom Role (permission "See the Conversations Panel"); administrators always can.
SETTINGS.ORANGE_UNTIL: Queue becomes "waiting for a long time" after
SETTINGS.RED_HINT: Up to that time the conversation stays in "Waiting in the queue"; after it, it turns red.
SETTINGS.LIST_LIMIT_HELP: How many conversations each card shows when opened.
SETTINGS.SOUND: Play a sound when a conversation enters red (each person can turn it on or off in the panel)
SETTINGS.PREVIEW: With these times, right now there would be:
SETTINGS.PREVIEW_ERROR: Could not calculate the preview right now.

HANDLED.TITLE: Handled today by agent
HANDLED.DESCRIPTION: Conversations each agent handled today: the ones they resolved today plus the ones currently being served by them.
